summary: Agent-facing semantic manifest for the Finbook MCP/tool surface. Describes what the system means, which tools exist, and how to use them safely without exposing transport or storage internals.

systemSemantics.purpose: Finbook manages personal tax truth for one repository as account-centered financial records plus append-only reference data and computed tax reports.

topLevelModel.meaning: Repo-wide settings and append-only reference tables shared across accounts.
Each account contains transactional tables plus append-only profile/reference data.

accountModel.identity: Accounts are addressed by account code or display name.
accountModel.governanceBoundary: Account creation, enable or disable state, row locking, journal materialization, commit, and discard are governance or runtime actions and are not agent-safe MCP tools.

transactionalTables.meaning: Manual capital gains not derived from stock purchase/sale lots.
Foreign-source income such as dividends or interest.
Stock purchase lots and transfer-ins. PurchaseLotID identifies sale-referenceable lots.
Stock sale lots and transfer-outs. PurchaseLots references prior purchase lots.

orientation: Start with finbook.describe_semantic_structure when the model, table meaning, or preferred mutation path is unclear.
Use finbook.get_contract when you need the machine-readable contract for the live tool surface.
readOrder: Prefer targeted reads first: finbook.list_accounts, finbook.get_repo_config, finbook.get_account_profile, finbook.list_table_rows, and finbook.get_computed_view.
Use finbook.list_journal_entries or finbook.get_journal_summary when the question is specifically about pending uncommitted changes.
Use finbook.get_working_state or finbook.get_committed_state only as fallback reads for broad reasoning.
Prefer finbook.get_computed_view for named computed views and use finbook.run_report only as a compatibility alias.
writeOrder: Prefer append-only tools for master data: finbook.append_repo_config_entry and finbook.append_account_profile_entry.
Prefer semantic transactional write tools before generic row tools.
Use finbook.upsert_row and finbook.delete_row only when no more specific semantic tool applies.
validation: Call finbook.validate_working_state after tool-based writes before concluding work or asking for follow-up action.

orientation.name: finbook.get_contract
orientation.purpose: Return the live machine-readable contract for the Finbook MCP/tool surface.

orientation.name: finbook.describe_semantic_structure
orientation.purpose: Explain the meaning of the Finbook model, tables, computed views, and preferred write paths.

orientation.name: finbook.get_schema
orientation.purpose: Return schema metadata for supported tables and computed fields.

targetedReads.name: finbook.list_accounts
targetedReads.purpose: List the known Finbook accounts in the connected repository.

targetedReads.name: finbook.get_repo_config
targetedReads.purpose: Read repo-wide configuration and append-only reference tables.

targetedReads.name: finbook.get_account_profile
targetedReads.purpose: Read append-only account profile and reference data for a single account.

targetedReads.name: finbook.list_table_rows
targetedReads.purpose: Read computed rows for one table, optionally scoped by financial year.

targetedReads.name: finbook.get_computed_view
targetedReads.purpose: Return one named computed view such as holdings, capital gains, or income summary for an account.

fallbackReads.name: finbook.get_committed_state
fallbackReads.purpose: Return the fully committed state snapshot for broad reasoning when targeted reads are insufficient.

fallbackReads.name: finbook.get_working_state
fallbackReads.purpose: Return the current working state snapshot, including pending runtime changes, as a fallback broad read.

journalReads.name: finbook.list_journal_entries
journalReads.purpose: Return the effective uncommitted journal entries contributing to the current working state since the last commit.

journalReads.name: finbook.get_journal_summary
journalReads.purpose: Return a user-oriented summary of the effective uncommitted journal entries contributing to the current working state.

appendOnlyWrites.name: finbook.append_repo_config_entry
appendOnlyWrites.purpose: Append one repo-level master-data or reference entry without rewriting the whole category.

appendOnlyWrites.name: finbook.append_account_profile_entry
appendOnlyWrites.purpose: Append one account-level master-data or reference entry without rewriting the whole category.

semanticTransactionalWrites.name: finbook.record_stock_purchase
semanticTransactionalWrites.purpose: Record a stock purchase or transfer-in entry.

semanticTransactionalWrites.name: finbook.record_stock_sale
semanticTransactionalWrites.purpose: Record a stock sale or transfer-out entry.

semanticTransactionalWrites.name: finbook.record_income
semanticTransactionalWrites.purpose: Record salary, foreign, property, or other income using the named income family.

semanticTransactionalWrites.name: finbook.record_capital_gain_outside_stock_transactions
semanticTransactionalWrites.purpose: Record manual or externally computed capital gains that do not come from tracked lot sales.

genericCorrections.name: finbook.upsert_row
genericCorrections.purpose: Create or update a row when no more specific semantic write tool applies.

genericCorrections.name: finbook.delete_row
genericCorrections.purpose: Delete a row by reference as a generic correction tool.

validation.name: finbook.validate_working_state
validation.purpose: Validate structural integrity of the current working state after writes.

recordExtraction: Prefer finbook.list_accounts, finbook.get_account_profile, finbook.get_repo_config, finbook.list_table_rows, and finbook.get_computed_view for targeted context.
Use finbook.describe_semantic_structure when table meaning or write-path choice is unclear.
claimRecording: Prefer finbook.list_accounts, finbook.get_account_profile, finbook.list_table_rows, and finbook.get_computed_view before broad state reads.
claimVerification: Prefer finbook.get_computed_view, finbook.list_table_rows, and finbook.get_account_profile for verification reasoning.

guardrails: Use the Finbook MCP/tool surface instead of editing raw state files directly.
Do not treat committed or working state snapshots as the default query surface; use them only as fallback reads.
Do not treat admin export dumps as part of the agent-safe MCP surface; use targeted computed-view tools instead.
Do not assume governance or runtime actions such as commit, discard, journal replay, row locking, or account lifecycle controls are available as agent-safe tools.
